masterDeclarationIdentity.grammar: Exactly one terminal [@master-ordinal=N]; N canonical ASCII decimal in 1..1000000, occurrences=1; structural names only elsewhere. Required for these diagnostic kinds, forbidden everywhere else. Not evaluated as XPath.

counterPolicy.details: Document P2 is normative for reserved settlement revisions; no saturation or JS Number conversion.

capabilityTransport.auth: existing single-operator auth guard; disabled only in existing desktop/test model
capabilityTransport.bodyOrigin: same-origin application/json; no cross-origin CORS grant

crossFieldRules: All object keys required, no unexpected or duplicate keys; null is explicit.
Profile limits must match selected name exactly; LARGE acknowledgement true only for large, false for standard.
0 <= receivedBytes <= declaredBytes <= source cap; sealed sha implies received=declared and exact EOF.
Only settling may retain non-open gate before phase advancement; cancellation atomically changes phase to settling.
Outside settling/terminal failure is null; commit.pending evidence=notAttempted.
Committed iff commitReturnedOk; unknown evidence is ambiguousCommit/unresolvedRollback/workerLost.
Terminal cancelled/stale/expired require cleanup complete; any failed cleanup changes these intended outcomes to failed, preserving commit notCommitted.
Succeeded may have cleanup quarantined; failure remains null and cleanup.failureKind is required then.
Accepted apply commandId is retained forever within full record even when spent; unavailable/available have null commandId.
Result and preview public artifact kind/id/digest/counts must bind exact handle and never change; artifact counts are complete, not sample counts.
Backup published/retained has non-null name+identity and fileAndDirectorySyncAcknowledged; staging has null public name+identity.
StopCause non-null iff gate cancelAccepted; commitClaimed never becomes cancelAccepted.
No automatic retry/recreate/reapply after unavailable or unknown; root/UI contract unchanged.
All x-maxUtf8Bytes/x-maxSerializedUtf8Bytes and decimal maxima are normative parser checks, not JSON Schema extensions evaluated by default.
Baggage unavailable has null counts and no invented declaration/payload rows; available exact measured rows including zero.
Baggage resolved iff memberPath non-null; invalid/missing have memberPath null. Nested read has all four exact counts, otherwise all null.
All source_names aliases from each InstallReport are represented by provenance with packageKey and authoritative raw alias retained.

unsupportedMediaType.message: The request media type is not supported.

bodyLimit.message: The request body exceeds the admitted limit.

outcomeUnavailable.message: The retained outcome is unavailable; do not retry installation automatically.

incarnationChanged.message: The server lifetime changed; the previous outcome is unavailable.

staleOffer.message: The admission offer is no longer current.

commandConflict.message: The command conflicts with the retained command.

invalidPhase.message: The command is not allowed in this job phase.

uploadNotReplayable.message: The upload cannot be resumed or replaced; inspect the same job.

catalogueUpdateStale.message: The catalogue or bound source changed; installation was not admitted.

uploadLengthMismatch.message: The upload length does not match the declared length.

serverStopping.message: The server is stopping; no new catalogue operation was admitted.

counterExhausted.message: A bounded operation counter is exhausted; admission is closed.

artifactStoreUnavailable.message: Private catalogue artifacts are unavailable; admission is closed.

catalogueAdmissionLimit.message: The catalogue exceeds the job input limit.

catalogueGrowthLimit.message: The operation exceeds the catalogue main-database growth limit.

resultLimit.message: The complete result exceeds the job result policy.

recordLimit.message: A required complete evidence record exceeds the job record policy.

publicProjectionRefused.message: Required consent evidence cannot be safely projected.

unsupportedCatalogue.message: This catalogue configuration is outside the supported job lane.

legacyProductDatabase.message: This source requires the separate legacy import workflow.

writerTimeout.message: The catalogue writer could not be acquired within the wait policy.

reportMismatch.message: The live install evidence disagreed with the admitted rehearsal.

cleanupFailed.message: Owned artifacts could not be completely settled.

outcomeUnknown.message: The commit outcome is unknown; automatic retry is forbidden.

ownership.leasePrimitive: rustix::fs::flock NonBlockingLockExclusive; stable inode never unlink
ownership.startupReclamation: under exclusive stable-root lease; known regular files only; unknown/retained/identity mismatch quarantines, closes admission
ownership.quarantineAdmission: fail closed until explicit owned repair; no automatic byte amnesty
ownership.backupDisposition: published before live DML, outside volatile root, never startup swept; known notCommitted removes only verified owned target; unknown/committed retain

externalDependency: Managed binding/witness/owner integration is separately owned; this package does not design or certify it.
